preview.label: Preview mode
preview.body: No authentication exists yet, so this panel is unprotected and reachable in development only. Everything you see is mock data and nothing you change is saved.

search.title: Search the admin
search.description: Find products, categories, brands, customers, orders, pages and settings.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unread: {count, plural, =0 {No unread} one {# unread} other {# unread}}
notifications.emptyDescription: Low stock warnings and order updates appear here.

localized.label: Translations
localized.hint: Every language must be filled in before this can be published.
localized.missing: Missing {count, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}

seo.title: Search engine listing
seo.description: How this appears in search results and when someone shares the link. Left empty, each field falls back to the one above it.
seo.keywordsHint: Search terms, not translated. Press Enter to add.
seo.slugHint: The address segment for this language. Changing it breaks existing links.
seo.metaTitleHint: Falls back to the record's name.
seo.metaDescriptionHint: Falls back to the record's description.
seo.canonicalHint: Absolute, starting with https://. Leave empty unless this page duplicates another.
seo.socialDescription: What appears when the link is posted to a social network or a messenger.
seo.ogTitleHint: Falls back to the meta title.
seo.ogDescriptionHint: Falls back to the meta description.
seo.ogImageHint: A storage path inside this module's bucket, not a URL. Falls back to the primary image.
seo.twitterCardHint: Applies to every language. A large image in one and a small one in another is an inconsistency, not a translation.

confirm.deleteManyTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}?

readOnly.body: Your role can view this but not change it.

notSaved.title: Nothing was saved
notSaved.body: The admin runs on mock data until the services land, so this form does not persist.

details.description: Everything recorded about this row. Editing opens the full editor.

history.title: History
history.description: Every change to this record, newest first.
history.emptyDescription: Changes appear here as soon as someone makes one.

media.count: {count, plural, =0 {No files} one {# file} other {# files}}
media.unavailable: Uploading needs Supabase Storage, which is not connected yet. Existing files can be reordered and described.
media.altHint: Describe the image for someone who cannot see it. Translated, because a screen reader reads it in the visitor's language.
